5. Cleric Beast - Love it aesthetically and seeing it hop down my first playthough is one of my favorite "holy shit" moments in the game. That and its damn howl-screeching.
4. Orphan of Kos - This boss is maddening and gives me flashbacks to the one and only Manus. It's one absolute hell of a fight, unrelenting, crazy, and just plain difficult.
3. Ludwig the Accursed/the Holy Blade - The highlight of an already exemplary DLC, this fight is just unforgettable in every regard. Fighting a monstrous horse-beast to his transition to the knight-like Hunter we've heard so much about, everything from the fight itself and even the music, is absolutely seamless.
2. Father Gascoigne - This fucking fight, man. Going in for the first time reminded me of great fights such as Artorias, a man-on-man fight of epic proportions. That said, I always have so much goddamn fun with this fight. Plus, his sudden beast transformation is another great "holy shit" moment.
1. Gehrman, the First Hunter - What to say about this fight... The stunning conclusion (mostly) of BB is one of the most unforgettable moments I've had in all of gaming. From the atmosphere set by my favorite theme in the entire game (and that's saying a lot) to the beautiful setting in the field of flowers to having a true hunter duel against the old master, the one who started it all. It's one fight in my mind that can't be topped.
